name: Frey Ringitt
source:
She is known as one of the best warriors in the Royal Capital.

Frey is well-trained through daily training. She is in the service of the Erzan family and has been entrusted with the task of guarding [url=/c23633]Alice[/url]. She has watched over Alice since she was very young.

Despite her cool appearance, she holds intense feelings in her heart. She hates to lose and is surprisingly passionate.

At first, she viewed [url=/c42047]Tomohiro[/url] as simply a tool to amplify her magic power but through successive battles against demons and his unexpected results she begins to view him as a member of the opposite sex.

[Translated from [url=https://hadashi.product.co.jp/3ping/char.html]the game's Official Homepage[/url].]
